description: What every fleet site must declare and wire before it counts as observable. Checked by scripts/conformance.mjs; drift feeds /v1/drift/repair agent tasks.

requirements.description: Manifest declares id, name, domain, source.path, runtime, capabilities, interfaces, standards, sensors.
Homepage reachable; http.status observation present and healthy.
llms.txt and robots.txt return 2xx (satisfies agent-discovery v2 llms-txt requirement).
cloudflare-workers sites declare cloudflare_worker so api.calls/cf.errors flow via cf-usage; other runtimes attach middleware or declare an exemption in manifest.telemetry_exemptions.
Machine-readable health endpoint (e.g. /api/health) for cheap deep probes.

telemetry_bindings.node-ssr: Astro/Express middleware emitting canonical events to control plane (requires public control plane URL)
